title: No trial or preview
body: Onboarding is very long, I could not see what I need to pay for
author: catdevonrex

title: A lot of steps before you know the price
body: You have to go through a lot of steps and read a lot of information before knowing that there is no free version and how much you need to pay. I really can not afford 12$ a month or pay for a yearly subscription at once. Just frustrated me a lot
author: yarr._.a

title: Ну таке
body: Задум хороший, але якось воно не співпадає з ціллю допомогти «людям що тонуть» - адже не має безкоштовної основи
